title: QuotaEstimate
description: Provider-account capacity metadata, separate from local accounting/1. Optional fields preserve historical caches. Credits are not money, token totals or measured charges.

available.description: Legacy conservative Bridge routing eligibility, not credit-spending authorization or external process liveness.

remaining_ratio.description: Included plan-window ratio; meaningless as a credit balance. Missing windows do not establish 100% allowance.

refresh_failed_at.description: A failed refresh makes retained values historical immediately.

account_identity_hash.description: Pseudonymous linked sign-in marker. This is not a stable workspace ID.

available_reset_credits.description: Earned rate-limit reset count. Never add it to spendable credits.

balance.description: Exact nonnegative provider decimal string in credits, not USD. Missing is unknown, not zero.
